items.title: Crypto longs lose $404 million in four hours as bitcoin briefly slips below $80,000
items.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $773 million on Thursday and Friday after three days of net inflows, per SoSoValue data.

items.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
items.summary: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

items.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
items.summary: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose Over $635M In One Day Following Oil Price Spike
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs recorded heavy outflows after an oil price spike.

items.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
items.summary: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

items.title: Initia halts network after security incident as attacker reportedly mints tokens
items.summary: Onchain data shows a $2.7 million ether transfer as Initia investigates the scope of a security incident.

items.title: Arthur Hayes exits crypto trading positions as analysts track $26 million in sales
items.summary: Arthur Hayes has exited Maelstrom's directional crypto positions, and on-chain analysts are tracking about $26 million in token sales.

items.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
items.summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture's proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC's innovation exemption.

items.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
items.summary: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.

items.title: Hong Kong's Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
items.summary: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

items.title: Argentine judge clears Milei and 10 others in LIBRA case, finding no 'criminally relevant deception'
items.summary: The judge's 60-page ruling concluded Argentine President Javier Milei's post promoting the LIBRA token did not, by itself, establish fraud.

items.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
items.summary: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

items.title: Firedancer makes bounty hunters burn 1 SOL even for duplicate bug reports
items.summary: The spring contest allowed eligible duplicates to earn rewards, while a retrospective links repeated discoveries partly to slow review.

items.title: Circle's new USDC auctions let institutions collect the fees others pay to cash out
items.summary: Eligible institutions can collect rebates funded by matched redeemers, whose auction fees are capped at the Express rate.

items.title: Kraken drops Monero spending questions but keeps a $1,500 rolling 30-day withdrawal cap for individuals
items.summary: Crypto exchange Kraken has withdrawn intrusive compliance demands sent to Monero customers after its co-CEO admitted the requests were unjustified.

items.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
items.summary: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

items.title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
items.summary: Days before Israel's election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions.

items.title: Netanyahu seeking blockchain plan to prepare for possible sanctions
items.summary: Netanyahu says blockchain could help Israel prepare for possible sanctions targeting its banking system.

items.title: NY Seeks $1.37 Billion Judgment Against Operators of NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Scheme
items.summary: Two successive crypto frauds took investors for more than $1.1 billion. New York's attorney general is asking a court to make the operators pay it back with interest.

items.title: Blockstream Launches Institutional Consulting Services, Opens Lugano Office
items.summary: Blockstream will offer its engineering expertise to banks and asset managers from a new Swiss base.

items.title: Bitcoin Core Ends Long Embargoes for Bugs AI Can Rediscover
items.summary: Bitcoin Core is adjusting disclosure timelines for vulnerabilities that AI tools can more easily rediscover.

items.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
items.summary: Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption.

items.title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
items.summary: The Democratic senator is seeking details on a reported agreement involving Bo Hines and Tether.

items.title: Sen. Blumenthal seeks answers from Tether over payments to firm founded by ex-White House crypto adviser
items.summary: Sen. Blumenthal said he wants answers from Tether following reports that it paid millions to a firm started by a former WH crypto adviser.
